title: 第9章
content_zh:
郭怀看了看夏真钰还真不知道自己能不能做主让她回去，周市长的心思他还不能确定，要不就先让她回去算了，虽说今天也有女同事在，但夏真钰的身份也确实不适合出席这种场合。
刚想答应就看见周瑾宇的秘书走过来了，赶紧把话憋了回去，秘书对郭怀点了下头就对夏真钰说：周市长的车在那边呢，夏小姐和我过去吧。
夏真钰求助的看了郭主任一眼，想让他帮自己挡一挡，结果郭怀差点就把她直接打包送过去，生怕她走慢一点触怒了周瑾宇。
上了车夏真钰是有些不高兴的，不明白周瑾宇为什么总是拽着自己不放，总让自己陪什么饭局，也顾不上对方是ＢＯＳＳ级的领导，一声不吭的生闷气。
怎么了？什么事不高兴？周瑾宇问，嗓音悦耳，磁性十足，但也没能安抚夏真钰暴躁的心。
没什么，只是觉得这种场合我不太适合出席。夏真钰看也不看周瑾宇回答得直接。
就这事儿不高兴？你这脾气还真不小，小杜先送真钰回家，再去饭店。姓杜的秘书答应了立即和司机说了夏真钰家的地址，车转了方向。
这样行了吗？病人还是少生些气的好，是不是刚才吃了药有些犯困了，你先睡会儿到了我叫你。周瑾宇优雅的语调带着说不出的温存。
夏真钰心里却打起了寒颤，这是什么话，称呼不对、内容不对、语气不对、态度就更不对了，自己就是再不多想也不可能了。周瑾宇这样，自己就是多想也正常吧，男女之间本来就容易生事儿。自己就是再贬低自己，也感觉不太对劲。看来不管自己是不是自己往脸上贴金，也得适当的保持距离了。
于是也不多说，直接闭上眼睛休息，脑子里想着今后如何能避开周瑾宇，宁可自己小心过头也不能让万分之一的可能发生。
作者有话要说：码这一章，光光连厕所都没去，憋着呢！我的膀胱，我做主！

☆、已婚身份
自从上次周瑾宇对自己表现出的态度，夏真钰就一直感到不安，如果万一周瑾宇真对自己有那种想法该怎么办。
当然这种事情在她们这种单位是司空见惯的了，但前提也是你情我愿，互有所图，自己可不想走这条路，虽然找个靠山工作上会有很多特权，别说自己这关过不去，到时自己爸妈也不用做人了。
心烦了几天，周瑾宇那边却没什么动静，又过了些日子夏真钰的心也放了下来，还好虚惊一场，自己还真是想太多了，还是把重心放在李巍身上的好。
这些天她和李巍已经沟通得很好了，互相吐露心事，虽说依然没有实质进展，但感情却比恋爱时还要亲密些，李巍已经同意如果再过一星期还是不行的话，就准备去医院了。夏真钰始终认为李巍这种情况，基本就是心理因素造成的。
这天夏真钰嘱咐李巍上班时把水、电、煤气都关好，自己就出了家门，今天她起得早所以不急着赶公交车，只慢慢的向车站走去。还没到车站呢手机就响了起来，正纳闷这么早谁会打电话来，拿出手机只见是个陌生的号码，于是接起电话喂了一声。
是个男人的声音：早啊。
夏真钰说道：不好意思，我没听出来您是哪位

对方笑了：我的声音都听不出来？
夏真钰想了想试探的问了句：您是周－市－长？
周瑾宇愉快的笑了：是我。
夏真钰脑子都不够用了，直接问：您这么早给我打电话有什么事儿吗？
没事，不过是在路上看见你了，打个招呼。
就是打个招呼？夏真钰摸不着头脑。
周瑾宇很直白的说道：是啊，一大早就看见你心情好。
夏真钰勉强笑了下：那真是我的荣幸。说完就想挂电话，却突然想起一个问题，又连忙说道：您看见我了？
周瑾宇又被夏真钰迟钝的反应逗乐了：我在你后面呢，你刚才过马路我就看见你了。
夏真钰迅速回过头，果然看见一辆黑色路虎在自己后边缓缓跟着，立即挂了电话向车走去，周瑾宇放下车窗看着夏真钰笑得很亲切。
看来自己真得说清楚了，不然这样下去还得了，郭主任可能早都看出来周瑾宇的意图了吧，不然怎么会对自己这么照顾和器重了，就自己还傻呵呵的呢。不，也许市政府那些人也都看出来了，想到这夏真钰心都翻了个儿，管他什么市长不市长的，自己的尊严和名声是第一位的。
整理下思路，保持笑容客气的说：周市长好，这么早就去办公啊，怎么没让司机送？
周瑾宇依旧表情不变：太早了没让司机来回跑，上车吧我送你。
夏真钰倒没推辞直接坐进了副驾驶，自己还没坐过这么好的车呢，真是宽敞舒适。
周瑾宇没发动车，而是倾身过来把安全带给她系上了，对于周瑾宇这个举动，夏真钰还是面不改色。
现在到单位估计早了些，要不我们先去吃个早餐？
开这辆车到单位能不早吗？夏真钰不以为然，现在她根本没办法把周瑾宇当成上级领导看待，根本就是个见色心喜的色＼狼，于是笑了笑说道：不用了周市长，麻烦您把我送到奉武街就好了，我在那下车，我妈正好找我有点事儿，要不我也不能起这么早。
周瑾宇愣了一下：这不是你家吗？
夏真钰笑得更灿烂了：是我家啊，不过这是我自己家，我娘家在奉武街。
你——，结婚了？周瑾宇问得有些犹豫。

当然啦，我都２８岁了结婚了不是很正常吗？
周瑾宇心里明白当时夏真钰间接说明自己年龄的时候，那么她是已婚身份是很正常的事，也在意料之中，不过他还是存了一丝侥幸，因为夏真钰真不像结了婚的女人，她看起来太年轻了，而且这几次的相处夏真钰表现得更不像一个在机关工作多年老于世故的人。
看着周瑾宇阴晴不定的脸，已经不见了平时的温文尔雅，夏真钰心里一阵痛快，看你这回还存什么妄想，当然她也不想太让周瑾宇下不来台，虽然不能接受他的为人但也得罪不起。
周瑾宇发动了汽车，一路上并没有再和夏真钰交谈，到了地方转头对夏真钰说：到了，下车吧。
夏真钰还真是拿不准周瑾宇现在是什么态度，语气还是那么温和其他方面也一点看不出什么变化，于是道了谢便过马路去了自己妈妈家。
夏妈妈看女儿这大早起的就来了吓一跳，连忙问怎么回事。夏真钰就说自己早上看错时间起太早了，去单位也没意思就回家了。
夏妈妈把早饭给端了上来，一家三口吃早餐好像已经是很久之前的事情了，夏真钰还真的是怀念，还是家里最舒服。
看着夏真钰过马路，进了对面的小区的周瑾宇现在说不出自己是什么感觉，他知道夏真钰刚才是故意的，很明显是想同他划清关系，其实他还没想过对夏真钰到底是抱着什么样的态度，结果也不用想直接就堵死了。
他周瑾宇有过不少女人，其中也有工作关系上的，但都是各取所需，已婚女人他是从来不动的，甚至是敬而远之。这样的女人太麻烦，而且一旦说开了影响也不好，他是不在乎什么影响的，可却也不屑去破坏别人的合法婚姻罢了。
想了想，轻笑一声。算了，两相情愿的事儿，既然夏真钰表明了态度，而他周瑾宇更不会去碰已婚女人，就当什么也没发生过吧。
又看了眼夏真钰离开的方向，踩下油门风驰而去。
解决了周瑾宇这件事，真是让夏真钰去了块心病，虽然还没完全确定，不过以周瑾宇的身份自然有他的骄傲，绝不会与已婚的自己过不去的。
况且这些天市里也没再让郭主任去汇报工作，就是有关系统的问题也是直接打电话到信息中心的沟通的，看来是真的相安无事了。
又到了周五晚上，李巍给她打了电话，说今晚订了酒店的房间，要和她去过二人世界，也能增加情趣，说不定就能成事儿。
其实夏真钰真有些打怵，试了那么多次了，每次都很疼，疼得她有些怕了。虽然有些不情愿，可也盼着李巍能真好起来，那才是真正的婚姻呀。
做了不少心里建设总算好过了一些，下了班先和李巍去餐厅吃了饭，吃完又逛了会儿街，李巍给夏真钰买了不少小玩意儿讨她开心，快九点时两人说说笑笑的去了预定的酒店，进了房间夏真钰才知道李巍订的是情侣套房，房间布置得非常温馨浪漫，自己也不禁高兴起来。
李巍，你可真舍得啊，这么高档的酒店你也敢订？夏真钰有些心疼钱。
为了我媳妇，我什么都舍得。媳妇，去洗澡啊？李巍换了衣服笑问夏真钰。
好啊，你要先洗吗？那我等会儿。
李巍呵呵笑着：傻媳妇，这种情侣套房怎么能一个人洗呢，咱俩洗鸳鸯浴

夏真钰唰的一下红了脸，但也没拒绝，今天一定要成功。
进了浴室还真是为情侣准备的，浴缸超大还带按＼摩的，李巍开始放水，夏真钰则先去洗淋浴。等李巍也冲了沐浴过来，夏真钰羞涩的帮他解了浴＼袍，二个人一起进了浴缸。
李巍轻吻着夏真钰，比以前有技巧得多，不再胡乱发狠，看来这段时间也学了不少，慢慢的夏真钰也有些情动，开始回应李巍的吻。
李巍在水中的手抚＼过夏真钰滑润的皮肤，吻也逐渐遍布夏真钰的全身，缠＼绵了好一会儿，李巍的一只手一直都在刺＼探夏真钰的花＼蕾，而他自己也随着夏真钰的配合，兴＼奋了起来。
content_en:
Guo Huai looked at Xia Zhenyu and really didn't know if he could make the decision to let her go back. He was not sure about Mayor Zhou's thoughts, so he might as well let her go back first. Although there were female colleagues here today, Xia Zhenyu's status was indeed not suitable for attending such an occasion.
Just as he was about to agree, he saw Zhou Jinyu's secretary coming over. He quickly suppressed his words. The secretary nodded to Guo Huai and said to Xia Zhenyu: Mayor Zhou's car is over there. Miss Xia and I can go there.
Xia Zhenyu glanced at Director Guo for help, asking him to block her, but Guo Huai almost packed her up and sent her over, fearing that she would offend Zhou Jinyu by walking slower.
Xia Zhenyu was a little unhappy when he got in the car. He didn't understand why Zhou Jinyu kept dragging her and asking him to accompany him to dinner parties. He didn't care that the other party was a BOSS-level leader and sulked silently.
What's wrong? What are you unhappy about? Zhou Jinyu asked, his voice was pleasant and magnetic, but it failed to appease Xia Zhenyu's irritable heart.
It's nothing, I just don't think I'm suitable for this kind of occasion. Xia Zhenyu answered directly without looking at Zhou Jinyu.
Are you unhappy about this? You really have a bad temper. Xiao Du will send Zhen Yu home first and then go to the restaurant. The secretary surnamed Du agreed and immediately told the driver the address of Xia Zhenyu's home, and the car changed direction.
Is this okay? It's better for the patient to be less angry. Are you a little sleepy after taking the medicine just now? You need to sleep for a while. I'll call you when you get here. Zhou Jinyu's elegant tone was filled with indescribable tenderness.
Xia Zhenyu shuddered in his heart. What were these words? The title was wrong, the content was wrong, the tone was wrong, and the attitude was even worse. It was impossible even if he didn't think more about it. It's normal for Zhou Jinyu to think too much. It's easy for men and women to get into trouble. No matter how much I belittle myself, it still feels wrong. It seems that no matter whether you are putting money on your face or not, you still have to keep an appropriate distance.
So he didn't say much, just closed his eyes and rested, thinking about how to avoid Zhou Jinyu in the future. He would rather be too careful than let the one in ten thousand possibility happen.

☆、Married status
Xia Zhenyu has been feeling uneasy since Zhou Jinyu's attitude toward him last time. What if Zhou Jinyu really thinks that way about him.
Of course, this kind of thing is common in a unit like theirs, but the prerequisite is that you and I are willing to work together and have mutual intentions. I don't want to take this path. Although finding a backer will bring a lot of privileges at work, don't say that I can't get through it. Then my parents won't have to be human anymore.
After being upset for a few days, there was no movement from Zhou Jinyu. After a few days, Xia Zhenyu felt relieved. Fortunately, it was a false alarm. He really thought too much, so it was better to focus on Li Wei.
She and Li Wei have communicated very well these days, confiding their concerns to each other. Although there is still no real progress, the relationship is closer than when they were in love. Li Wei has agreed that if nothing works in another week, he will go to the hospital. Xia Zhenyu always believed that Li Wei's situation was basically caused by psychological factors.
That day, Xia Zhenyu asked Li Wei to turn off the water, electricity, and gas when she went to work, and then left the house. She got up early today, so she was not in a hurry to catch the bus, and just walked slowly to the station. Before I even arrived at the station, my phone rang. I was wondering who would call so early. I took out my phone and saw an unfamiliar number, so I picked up the phone and called him.
It was a man's voice: Good morning.
Xia Zhenyu said: Sorry, I didn’t hear who you are.
The other party laughed: Can't you hear my voice?
Xia Zhenyu thought for a while and asked tentatively: Are you Mayor Zhou?
Zhou Jinyu smiled happily: It's me.Xia Zhenyu was running out of ideas and asked directly: What's wrong with you calling me so early?
It's okay, I just saw you on the road and wanted to say hello.
Just say hello? Xia Zhenyu was confused.
Zhou Jinyu said straightforwardly: Yes, I saw you in a good mood early in the morning.
Xia Zhenyu forced a smile: That's really my honor. After saying that, I wanted to hang up the phone, but suddenly thought of a question and said quickly: Have you seen me?
Zhou Jinyu was amused by Xia Zhenyu's slow reaction again: I'm behind you. I saw you just now when you crossed the road.
Xia Zhenyu quickly turned around and saw a black Land Rover slowly following him. He immediately hung up the phone and walked towards the car. Zhou Jinyu lowered the window and looked at Xia Zhenyu with a friendly smile.
It seems that he really needs to make it clear, otherwise it will be worse if things continue like this. Director Guo may have figured out Zhou Jinyu's intentions long ago. Otherwise, why would he take such care and respect for himself, yet he would still be such a fool. No, maybe the people in the city government have also noticed it. Thinking of this, Xia Zhenyu's heart is turned upside down. It doesn't matter whether he is the mayor or not, his own dignity and reputation come first.
After sorting out his thoughts, he kept a smile and said politely: Hello, Mayor Zhou, you went to the office so early, why didn't you ask the driver to drop you off?
Zhou Jinyu's expression remained unchanged: It's too early to let the driver run back and forth. Get in the car and I'll take you off.
Xia Zhenyu didn't refuse and got into the passenger seat. He had never been in such a nice car before. It was really spacious and comfortable.
Zhou Jinyu didn't start the car, but leaned over and fastened her seat belt. Xia Zhenyu remained calm about Zhou Jinyu's move.
It's probably a little early to arrive at work now. How about we go have breakfast first?
Can I drive this car to work early? Xia Zhenyu disagreed. Now she had no way of treating Zhou Jinyu as a superior leader. He was simply a pervert who took pleasure in sex. So she smiled and said, "No, Mayor Zhou, please just take me to Fengwu Street. I got off the car there, and my mother happened to have something to do with me. Otherwise, I can't get up so early."
Zhou Jinyu was stunned for a moment: Isn't this your home?
Xia Zhenyu smiled even brighter: It's my home, but this is my own home. My natal home is on Fengwu Street.
You——, married? Zhou Jinyu asked hesitantly.
Of course, isn’t it normal for me to get married at the age of 28?
Zhou Jinyu knew in his heart that when Xia Zhenyu indirectly stated his age, it was normal and expected that she was married. However, he still took a chance, because Xia Zhenyu really didn't look like a married woman. She looked too young, and Xia Zhenyu behaved less like a sophisticated person who had worked in an agency for many years.
Looking at Zhou Jinyu's uncertain face, which was no longer as gentle as usual, Xia Zhenyu felt happy. Let's see what delusions you still have this time. Of course, she didn't want to make Zhou Jinyu stand down too much. Although she couldn't accept his behavior, she couldn't afford to offend him.
Zhou Jinyu started the car and did not talk to Xia Zhenyu along the way. When he got there, he turned to Xia Zhenyu and said: We are here, get out of the car.
Xia Zhenyu was really not sure what Zhou Jinyu's attitude was now. His tone was still so gentle and there was no change in other aspects, so he thanked him and crossed the road to his mother's house.
Mother Xia was startled to see her daughter coming up so early in the morning, and quickly asked what was going on. Xia Zhenyu said that he got up too early at the wrong time in the morning, and it was no fun to go to work, so he went home.
Xia's mother brought breakfast. It seemed like it had been a long time ago for a family of three to have breakfast. Xia Zhenyu really missed it. She was still the most comfortable at home.
Zhou Jinyu, who watched Xia Zhenyu crossing the road and entering the opposite community, couldn't explain how he felt now. He knew that Xia Zhenyu did it on purpose just now and obviously wanted to fight with him.To clear up the relationship, in fact, he hadn't thought about his attitude towards Xia Zhenyu, but in the end, he blocked it without even thinking about it.
He, Zhou Jinyu, has had many women, some of them in work relationships, but they all got what they wanted. He never touched married women, and even stayed away from them. Such a woman is too troublesome, and once the impact is revealed, he doesn't care about the impact, but he doesn't bother to destroy other people's legal marriages.
After thinking about it, he chuckled. Forget it, it's a consensual thing. Since Xia Zhenyu has made his attitude clear, and he, Zhou Jinyu, will never touch a married woman, just pretend that nothing happened.
Then he looked at the direction Xia Zhenyu left, stepped on the accelerator and drove away.
Solving Zhou Jinyu's matter really relieved Xia Zhenyu's heartache. Although it was not completely confirmed, Zhou Jinyu was naturally proud of his identity and would never have trouble with himself as a married man.
Moreover, the city no longer asks Director Guo to report on work these days. Even if there are problems related to the system, they are directly called to the information center for communication. It seems that everything is really going well.
On Friday night again, Li Wei called her and said that he had booked a hotel room tonight and wanted to go to the world of two with her, which would also increase the fun, and maybe it would work out.
In fact, Xia Zhenyu was really frightened. She had tried it so many times and it hurt every time. The pain made her a little scared. Although I am a little reluctant, I still hope that Li Wei will get better. That is a real marriage.
After doing a lot of mental work, I finally felt better. After work, I went to a restaurant with Li Wei for dinner, and then went shopping for a while. Li Wei bought Xia Zhenyu a lot of gadgets to make her happy. When it was almost nine o'clock, they went to the booked hotel chatting and laughing. After entering the room, Xia Zhenyu realized that Li Wei had booked a couple's suite. The room was very warm and romantic, and he couldn't help but feel happy.
Li Wei, you are so willing. Do you dare to book such a high-end hotel? Xia Zhenyu felt a little worried about money.
I would give up anything for my wife. Wife, are you going to take a shower? Li Wei changed his clothes and asked Xia Zhenyu with a smile.
OK, do you want to wash it first? Then I'll wait a moment.
Li Wei chuckled: Silly wife, how can one person take a bath in a couple's suite like this? Let's take a couple's bath together.
Xia Zhenyu blushed suddenly, but she didn't refuse. She must succeed today.
After entering the bathroom, it was really prepared for couples. The bathtub was very large and had a massage function. Li Wei started to run the water while Xia Zhenyu took a shower first. When Li Wei also took a shower, Xia Zhenyu shyly helped him take off his bathrobe, and the two of them got into the bathtub together.
Li Wei kissed Xia Zhenyu gently, much more skillfully than before, and no longer acted recklessly. It seemed that he had learned a lot during this period. Gradually, Xia Zhenyu became emotionally moved and began to respond to Li Wei's kiss.
Li Wei's hands in the water caressed Xia Zhenyu's smooth skin, and kisses gradually spread all over Xia Zhenyu's body. After lingering for a long time, one of Li Wei's hands was probing Xia Zhenyu's buds, and he himself became excited as Xia Zhenyu cooperated.
